purpose: Teach: 生殖/極度/入植/従属/太平洋戦争/払拭/多重/憎悪

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、生殖関連の科学犯罪を警察、捜査中ですね
lines.en: So the police are currently investigating this case involving reproductive science crimes, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, probing tone. Leans slightly forward with genuine intellectual curiosity. Careful articulation, measured pace. No judgment — seeking clarification and understanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、極度の貧困層への詐欺を取り締まっております
lines.en: The police department is actively cracking down on fraud targeting the extremely poor.
lines.style: Clear, official register. Steady delivery without inflection. Direct eye contact. The measured confidence of someone stating documented fact. Not cold — just precise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不法な入植地で起きた事件を警察、調査されたんですね
lines.en: So the police investigated what happened in that illegal settlement, then?
lines.style: Quieter than before. Genuine processing — this is harder territory. Slight hesitation, like he's thinking aloud. Respectful of the weight of the subject.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、組織犯罪の従属関係を解明しております
lines.en: We're currently working to clarify the hierarchical relationships within organized crime networks.
lines.style: Formal but not distant. Each phrase placed with care. Slight pause before 'hierarchical' — choosing the right word matters here. Professional composure held steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、太平洋戦争時代の遺品関連事件を警察、確認されましたね
lines.en: So the police confirmed the case involving heirlooms from the Pacific War era?
lines.style: Softer approach now. Something in his voice has shifted — this touches something. Still curious, but more reverent. Slower pace. Listening for what's not being said.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不安を払拭する広報を行っております
lines.en: The police are conducting public outreach to address and alleviate people's concerns.
lines.style: Slight warmth entering the official tone. Not abandoning formality, but acknowledging the human side of the work. Steady, reassuring pacing. A hint of care underneath the procedure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、多重債務絡みの事件を警察、捜査中ですね
lines.en: The police are investigating cases involving multiple debt situations, correct?
lines.style: Back to careful neutrality, but weighted. He's asking about real suffering — household collapse, desperation. His curiosity has an undertone of concern. Slower, deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、憎悪犯罪への対策を強化しております
lines.en: We're strengthening our response measures against hate crimes.
lines.style: Firmer now. The formality deepens slightly — this is serious territory. Conviction in the delivery, no apology in the words. Meeting the gravity of the subject directly.
